name: Sales Star Model

tables.name: Sales
tables.description: Invoiced sales transactions at order-line grain, in reporting currency.

tables.name: Customer
tables.description: Billed customer, deduplicated on the golden customer identifier.

tables.name: Product
tables.description: Sellable product with its commercial hierarchy and list price.

tables.name: Date
tables.description: Gregorian and fiscal calendar starting in July, one row per day.

columns.name: Order Date
columns.description: Date the order was confirmed. Primary date for all sales analysis.

columns.name: Ship Date
columns.description: Date the order left the warehouse. Use only for logistics analysis.

columns.name: Customer Key
columns.description: Surrogate key joining Sales to Customer.

columns.name: Fiscal Year
columns.description: Fiscal year label, starting in July.

columns.name: Postal Code
columns.description: Customer billing postal code, stored as a number in the source.

measures.name: Total Sales
measures.description: Net invoiced revenue excluding tax, in reporting currency.

measures.name: Gross Margin
measures.description: Net revenue minus standard cost. Preferred margin definition for all reporting.

measures.name: Standard Cost
measures.description: Standard cost of goods sold at order-line grain.

measures.name: YTD Sales
measures.description: Net revenue accumulated since the start of the fiscal year.

ai_instructions: Sales domain. When a user asks about revenue, sales or turnover, use [Total Sales]. When a user asks about margin, always use [Gross Margin]; never compute a margin from raw columns. The fiscal year starts on 1 July. Order Date is the primary date; use Ship Date only when the question is explicitly about logistics or delivery. A higher margin percentage is positive. When a question mentions a region without naming it, ask the user to clarify.
